# CircuitSynthesis

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The automated generation of circuit topologies from functional specifications, often via evolutionary search over graph-based representations. Core methodology for discovering novel computing architectures beyond human-designed circuits, critical for TCC's topology-driven paradigm.
